reasons: Result depends on the build tool.

terms.meaning: A tool that transforms CSS during the build.

sections.name: config
sections.title: Style processing setup
sections.what: Registers the Tailwind plugin so its styles are built into the app.
sections.why: Needed for Tailwind classes to work.
sections.watch_out: Removing this entry removes most of the app's styling.

summary: A small setup file that tells the build tool to run Tailwind CSS on the styles.
purpose: Turns the Tailwind style classes into the final CSS the browser uses.
why: Tailwind needs this step to work.
how: 1) Lists the Tailwind plugin. 2) Exports the list for the build to read.
risks: Removing the plugin removes most utility styles from the app.
debug: If styles disappear after a build, check that this plugin is listed.
